say:2:1631135002:1.text: Professor Stuart... is this... really true?
say:2:1631135002:1.source_cn: 斯图尔特老师……这是……真的吗？
say:2:1631135002:1.male: Professor Stuart... is this... really true?
say:2:1631135002:1.female: Professor Stuart... is this... really true?

say:3:1631135004:1.source_cn: 果然……老师他一直都记得这个约定。

say:4:1631135005:1.text: This gift is his final recognition of me.
say:4:1631135005:1.source_cn: ……这份礼物，便是他给予我的最终认可。
say:4:1631135005:1.male: This gift is his final recognition of me.
say:4:1631135005:1.female: This gift is his final recognition of me.

say:5:1631135006:1.text: Thank you very much. I will treasure this and strive to become a mentor as worthy of respect as my professor once was.
say:5:1631135006:1.source_cn: 非常感谢你。我必将这份认可铭记于心，努力成为像老师那样...
say:5:1631135006:1.male: Thank you very much. I will treasure this and strive to become a mentor as worthy of respect as my professor once was.
say:5:1631135006:1.female: Thank you very much. I will treasure this and strive to become a mentor as worthy of respect as my professor once was.
